name: Satsujinki no Traumerei
original_name: 刹人鬼のトロイメライ
source:
Liebi, a boy who has lost his memories, encounters a girl named Luce. As he interacts with her, he must struggle against the "murderous impulses" within him and ultimately confront his true nature.

[From [url=https://liuse.itch.io/the-killers-traumerei]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
失去记忆的男孩列比遇到了名叫露丝的女孩。当他与她互动时，他必须与内心的“杀人冲动”作斗争，并最终面对自己的真实本性。

[来自[url=https://liuse.itch.io/the-killers-traumerei]itch.io[/url]]
